A '''pillow''' was an object which came in various sizes and shapes, ranging from very small pillows to protect or display small items,<ref name="LOTFE" /> to those used to support an individual's head when lying down to rest or [[Sleep/Legends|sleep]],<ref name="Sacrifice" /> to pillows large enough to accommodate a [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] being's entire body<ref name="MF">[[Millennium Falcon (novel)|''Millennium Falcon'']]</ref> as well as using to hold during sleep or serve as items of furniture unto themselves.<ref name="ZTHR">''[[Zorba the Hutt's Revenge]]''</ref>

==Description==
Pillows could be made of a variety of materials, including foam that could yellow over time,<ref name="COTJ" /> [[gort]] feathers,<ref name="YJK07" /> [[Velvet/Legends|velvet]],<ref name="LOTFE" /> and [[Silk/Legends|silk]].<ref name="DBROT" />

[[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorians]] such as [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Ixsthmus]] slept on specially designed pillows. This was to accommodate the shape of an Ithorian's head.<ref name="SWCP">''[[Star Wars Campaign Pack]]''</ref>

==History==
[[File:Padme_ep2nitegown.jpg|thumb|left|[[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] in her bed, her pillows behind her.]]
Contrary to the spartan lifestyle of many Jedi, [[Valenthyne Farfalla]] had a lavish bedroom including bedding and pillows made of yellow and red [[Silk/Legends|silk]].<ref name="DBROT" /> The aspiring [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Set Harth]] had a perfumed pillow.<ref name="DBDOE">''[[Darth Bane: Dynasty of Evil]]''</ref>

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Padawan/Legends|padawans]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] would keep their [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] beneath their pillows as they slept.<ref name="BI">{{TCW|Brain Invaders}}</ref>

During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], there existed many types of throw pillows, including one type made from fragrant [[Grass/Legends|grasses]] of [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]]. These pillows were often used for [[Meditation/Legends|meditative]] techniques, but they were hard to come by as the greenery of Kuat was ferociously protected. [[Jareck Arned]] owned one such pillow in a meditation room in his valley home on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>

A [[Gallofree Yards, Inc./Legends|Gallofree Yards]] [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|GR-75 medium transport]], the [[Bright Hope/Legends|''Bright Hope'']], had [[Color/Legends|white]] pillows in its storage lockers, along with [[Bantha/Legends|bantha]]-wool [[Blanket/Legends|blankets]].<ref name="OPF" />

The [[most comfortable chair ever designed]], as of [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], was described as a sort of large floating pillow. Han Solo had one such chair at his [[Han Solo's sky house|sky house]].<ref name="ZTHR" />

When [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] absconded with [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] used a [[Psychometry/Legends|psychometric]] imprint from Solo's pillow as one of the clues to track him down.<ref name="COPL">''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]''</ref> [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] regularly kept a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] under his pillow while he slept,<ref name="COTJ" /><ref name="FOTJO">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Outcast]]''</ref> and [[Ben Skywalker]] occasionally kept a [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblade]] under his pillow.<ref name="Sacrifice" />

The [[Amulet of Kalara]] originally rested on a red [[Velvet/Legends|velvet]] pillow until it was taken from its display case on [[Almania]] by [[Faskus Olvidan]].<ref name="LOTFE" />
